reference.title: Release notes:
reference.shortdesc: The first release that anyone can try, with a one-step page to generate and measure two packs.

ul.li: The generate page: pick a system, get the authority pack and a downstream pack, and see the design's metrics measured on the run.
Three readers from one source: authority, downstream and public packs.
The four checks, with tests for each, including the leak test.
A private sandbox: propose a link, approve or reject it, record decisions, plant a leak, simulate a model update.
Pack download with the DITA-OT output, manifest, report, coverage table and SHA-256 hashes.
Release and seal by issue comment, for a code owner.
The Ask page: answers from the evidence corpus with checked quotes.

section.title: Not in this release
section.p: Uploading your own requirement set, the NIST AI RMF pack, a BigQuery register and dashboards.
